title: Breakups
summary: A breakup is the end of a romantic relationship. Grief, anger and loneliness afterwards are normal; healing usually involves time, support from friends, limiting contact and rebuilding routines.
key_points: If you're ending it: be honest, kind and clear, ideally in person or by call.
No-contact for a while often helps both people move on.
answer_guidance: Be warm and steady. For someone hurting, listen first; advice second.
